name: Jabesh
title: Father of King Shallum in Israel
summary: Jabesh was the father of Shallum, who revolted, killed King Zechariah, and became king in Israel for a month before he too was killed.

keyEvents.title: Father of King Shallum
keyEvents.description: Shallum, son of Jabesh, killed King Zechariah and reigned as king in Israel for a short time.
